bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
name=gace-createvdobot-videobot-poll-1
test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.State.Running}}' "$name" 2>/dev/null)" = true || exit 71
test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.State.Restarting}}' "$name" 2>/dev/null)" != true || exit 72
if docker logs --since 12h "$name" 2>&1 | grep -q '^CREATOR_POLL_RUNTIME_FAILED$';then exit 73;fi
docker logs --since 12h "$name" 2>&1 | grep -q '^CREATOR_DM_POLL_READY=PASS$' || exit 74
if docker ps --format '{{.Names}}' | grep -Eiq 'telegram[-_]bot[-_]api|local[-_]bot[-_]api';then exit 75;fi
exit 0
